fields.title: NOCOPO tender/award/contract record
fields.description: One record per Nigeria NOCOPO procurement process, produced by mode=list (a page of the Published Records table, optionally enriched with full detail) or mode=detail (one specific OCID's full OCDS release history). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a record can't be fetched.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: For list records: 'list' or 'list:search=<query>'. For detail records: the OCID that was requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which strategy emitted this record (S1-published-record-handler, S1-ocdsjson-detail, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (blocked_or_transient, not_found).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_detailError.title: Detail enrichment error
_detailError.description: Present only on a list-mode row when fetchDetail=true and that row's own detail fetch failed -- the rest of the row's list fields are still valid.

id.title: Internal ID
id.description: NOCOPO's own internal database row ID (list rows only).

ocid.title: OCID
ocid.description: The Open Contracting ID -- NOCOPO's stable identifier for this procurement process across its whole planning -> tender -> award -> contract lifecycle.

procuringEntity.title: Procuring entity
procuringEntity.description: The Ministry/Department/Agency (MDA) running this procurement (list rows only).

projectTitle.title: Project title
projectTitle.description: The project's title as published in the listing (list rows only).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: When this record was published on NOCOPO (list rows only).

packageNumber.title: Package number
packageNumber.description: The procuring entity's own package reference (list rows only).

lotNumber.title: Lot number
lotNumber.description: The procuring entity's own lot reference, when applicable (list rows only).

budgetYear.title: Budget year
budgetYear.description: The fiscal year this project's budget belongs to (list rows only).

tenderId.title: Tender ID
tenderId.description: The procuring entity's own tender reference number (detail, or list rows with fetchDetail=true).

buyerName.title: Buyer name
buyerName.description: The government buyer named on the record.

budgetAmount.title: Budget amount
budgetAmount.description: The planning-stage budget amount, when present.

budgetCurrency.title: Budget currency
budgetCurrency.description: Currency code for budgetAmount, e.g. NGN.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Union of OCDS release tags seen across this record's release history (e.g. ['planning', 'tender', 'award']).

awardsCount.title: Awards count
awardsCount.description: Number of award entries across this record's release history.

contractsCount.title: Contracts count
contractsCount.description: Number of contract entries across this record's release history.

totalAwardAmount.title: Total award amount
totalAwardAmount.description: Sum of all award value amounts on this record, when present.

awardCurrency.title: Award currency
awardCurrency.description: Currency code for totalAwardAmount, e.g. NGN.

latestReleaseDate.title: Latest release date
latestReleaseDate.description: The date of the most recent entry in this record's release history.

releases.title: Release history (full detail)
releases.description: The complete upstream OCDS 'releases' array verbatim, one entry per planning/tender/award/contract/implementation event -- present on detail records and list rows fetched with fetchDetail=true.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: The OCDS publisher block (name, scheme, uid) -- 'The Bureau of Public Procurement' / 'NG-BPP'.

publishedDate.title: Package published date
publishedDate.description: The release package's own publishedDate field, upstream.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across list and detail records -- rows missing a given column render blank.
